duḥkhabhañjana.en: Duḥkhabhañjana, 'breaker of sorrow', a name of Śani

nala.hi: नल, निषध देशके राजा, दमयन्तीके पति, जिन्होंने विपत्तिमें अपना राज्य खोया (लोककथामें शनिकी दशासे)
nala.en: Nala, king of Niṣadha and husband of Damayantī, who lost his kingdom in misfortune (in the folk telling, under Śani's period)
